card.name: Linking words inside clinical phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or partial drug names that sit just before a specific medical term is expected, such as 'to' before end stage renal disease or 'and' after trimethoprim.

modes.label: Link before disease term
modes.description: A short word like 'to', 'of' or 'for' right before an outcome or procedure name.
modes.example: progression<< to>> end stage renal disease

modes.label: Drug pairing
modes.description: A word or word part inside or right after a drug name, leading to a partner drug.

modes.label: Bracket or comma
modes.description: An opening bracket or comma before an abbreviation or consequence.
modes.example: acute liver failure<<,>> at times resulting in liver transplant

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and marks just before a named drug, disease or abbreviation.
